itemListElement.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch round cake pans.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Beat softened butter until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add powdered sugar gradually and beat until smooth.
